verdict.rationale: Gmail's own marketing says Gemini drafts and polishes emails and that suggested replies let you 'reply in one click, in your voice'; support docs add drafting and refining 'for tone and clarity.' The 'your voice' claim rests on a single marketing line. Hands-on reports about the related improve/polish suggestions say they can flatten personal style or turn a warm email cold, which tempers but does not directly refute the reply-voice claim. missing for 10: documented mechanism for learning the user's personal voice from their sent mail, in-depth docs on reply drafting with review before sending, independent corroboration that generated replies match the user's tone.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Gemini in Gmail saves you time drafting or polishing emails, and suggested replies help you reply in one click, in your voice.
Draft: Create new emails or refine existing drafts for tone and clarity.
